mapper.select: select ub.uid, ub.username, ub.real_name, ub.id_card, ub.gender, ub.birthday, ub.phone, ub.email, ub.create_time, ub.update_time, r.role_id, r.role_name, r.role_code, r.description from user_base ub left join user_role ur on ub.uid = ur.uid left join role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where ub.username = #{username}
